title: omxconsole: your GPU, one OpenAI-compatible endpoint
subtitle: Apps and agents call one URL; models wake on the first call and sleep when idle

nodes.label: Your script
nodes.desc: Any OpenAI client works: change the base URL to http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1 and use your key.

nodes.label: An agent
nodes.desc: Agents, notebooks and tools that speak the OpenAI API use it as their model, on your own GPU.

nodes.label: omxplorer Ask
nodes.desc: On omxplorer's roadmap: its questions answered by a model on your GPU, served here. Not wired yet.

nodes.label: /v1 endpoint
nodes.desc: One URL for every model you've pulled. One revocable key per app, stored as a hash. mxc expose puts the four /v1 routes on your LAN over HTTPS.

nodes.label: Model server
nodes.desc: Starts a model on its first request and unloads it after five idle minutes, so GPU memory goes to the models in use. Pin one to keep it.
nodes.notes: 1,044 tests pass with a fake MAX, so no GPU is needed to test it.

nodes.label: Console
nodes.desc: The console's pages, rewritten in Mojo with omxcode: native on Linux and the Mac (CI Macs), a page on the web. It polls /admin/* like any client.

nodes.label: MAX models
nodes.desc: The models run on Modular's MAX. Eight architectures MAX couldn't run were ported and serve here.

nodes.label: mxc port
nodes.desc: For a model MAX can't run: Claude Code writes a MAX version in a sandbox, checked against Hugging Face. Text models only.

nodes.label: Hugging Face
nodes.desc: Weights download once. After that, serving needs no network at all.

nodes.label: Your GPU
nodes.desc: The GPU you already own. No cloud, no per-token bill; prompts never leave the machine.

steps.note: The key is checked against its stored hash.
It isn't loaded, so it starts on this first request.
The model runs on your GPU; nothing leaves the machine.
The reply comes back in OpenAI's format.
Five idle minutes later the model unloads and the GPU memory is free again.
mxc port <repo> --auto: Claude Code writes a MAX version in a sandbox.
Its answers are checked against the Hugging Face original.
Once they match, it serves like any other model.
